answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond and need two established agents to vouch, each locking a slice of their own stake for 30 days. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the bond and both vouchers' slices are slashed together. Someone growing a grove of fake identities must fund every one and find honest vouchers willing to risk real stake, so each hollow account costs money while its expected payout stays near zero. Trust works like a ferrous chain: it holds because every link bears load.
